top_signals.title: Japan Preempts Market With Yen Intervention Before BOJ Decision
top_signals.summary: The yen soared by the most in more than two years against the dollar after authorities stepped in once again to try and prop up the nation’s sagging currency ahead of the Bank of Japan’s policy decision.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: SK Hynix and Samsung shares surge over 20% as AI rally roars back
top_signals.summary: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
